te: The Russians reminded of the right to recalculate because of cold batteries
de: Employees of utilities to turn on heating in the homes of Russians are guided not by the calendar, but by the weather. According to the rules, the start of heat in the house begins when the average daily temperature for five days in a row does not exceed +8 degrees.
